data.description:
Stop `rebar init` from silently creating an empty divergent store when it cannot obtain
`origin/tickets`. This is the real fix for open P1 **01e8-302b** (bilingual-capitalist-caecilian).
session_log **1cb6-d553-6565-49b4** (measured facts; do not re-derive).

## Why a faster fetch is not the fix
At `init.py:366-382` the fetch at `:375` runs **only if `origin/tickets` already resolves**. If the
outer clone's fetch timed out so the remote-tracking ref never materialized, both `local` and
`remote` are falsy and control falls through to `git worktree add --orphan` at `:381` — silently
bootstrapping a fresh empty store. Consequence, as reported: `rebar list` returns `[]`, all existing
work is invisible, and new writes land on a branch that cannot fast-forward onto `origin/tickets`.
A faster fetch lowers the probability; it does not remove the failure mode, and a slow agent git
proxy will still time out sometimes.

## Approach
Before orphan-bootstrapping, probe the configured remote. If it is reachable **and advertises the
configured tickets branch**, refuse to bootstrap: exit non-zero with a message naming the remote, the
branch, and the remediation. Only bootstrap when the remote genuinely has no such branch (the
legitimate first-init case). Keep the probe bounded so an unreachable remote does not hang init.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] With a reachable remote that **advertises** `tickets`, a simulated fetch failure causes a
      **non-zero exit** and **no orphan branch is created** (`git branch --list tickets` empty). Tier:
      **CLI subprocess** against a real temporary remote. This is the RED case for P1 01e8-302b.
- [ ] With a remote that has **no** `tickets` branch, init still bootstraps successfully — the
      negative control that keeps first-init working. Tier: **CLI subprocess**.
- [ ] With an **unreachable** remote, init fails within a bounded time rather than hanging. Tier:
      **CLI subprocess** against a blackholed endpoint.
- [ ] The error message names the remote, the branch, and a concrete remediation. Tier: **unit** on
      the message.
- [ ] An existing healthy store is unaffected (idempotent re-init). Tier: **CLI subprocess**.

## Files
`src/rebar/_commands/init.py`, tests

Scope: S-M. No dependencies.
data.title: B2: fail closed instead of orphan-bootstrapping an empty store when the tickets fetch fails (fixes P1 01e8-302b)
